description: Doctor provisioning and first-login password reset: Center admins can create doctor accounts with temporary passwords; doctors must reset password on first login; device tracking middleware and security alerts via email
steps: 1. Create lib/device-id.ts with getOrCreateDeviceId() (localStorage UUID for web) and getDeviceName() (parse user agent)

2. Create lib/middleware/device-tracking.ts with trackDevice(userId) function: reads X-Device-ID and X-Device-Name headers, validates UUID format, checks user_devices table, creates record if new, updates lastUsedAt if existing, returns {isNewDevice, deviceId}
3. Create lib/middleware/first-login-check.ts with checkFirstLogin() function: calls getAuthenticatedUser(), queries user's passwordResetRequired flag, returns {requiresReset, user}
4. Add sendNewDeviceAlertEmail(userEmail, userName, deviceId, otp) to lib/email.ts following existing template patterns

5. Create app/api/center/doctors/provision/route.ts: requireCenter(), validate email uniqueness, generate 16-byte temp password with 24h expiry, create user (role=DOCTOR, passwordResetRequired=true, emailVerified=false), create account via Better Auth (hash password), create doctor record (provisioned=true, provisionedBy=admin user, centerId=center's ID, active=true), send verification email, handle email failure gracefully (log + create notification), return doctor + tempPassword

6. Create app/api/auth/change-password-first-login/route.ts: getAuthenticatedUser(), check passwordResetRequired=true, verify tempPasswordExpiresAt not expired, verify old password via Better Auth, validate new password (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number), update password via Better Auth, set passwordResetRequired=false, lastPasswordChangeAt=now, tempPasswordExpiresAt=null, send confirmation email

7. Create app/api/auth/verify-device/route.ts: getAuthenticatedUser(), rate limit 3 attempts per deviceId (in-memory Map), fetch OTP from verifications table (identifier='device-verify:{deviceId}'), check expiration, hash submitted OTP and compare, mark device as trusted in user_devices, delete verification record, return success
8. Create middleware.ts in project root with Next.js middleware to inject x-pathname header for all /doctor/* routes

9. Create app/doctor/layout.tsx: call checkFirstLogin(), get pathname from headers, if requiresReset=true and pathname not in allowedPaths (/doctor/change-password, /api/auth/*, /auth/signout), redirect to /doctor/change-password

10. Create app/doctor/change-password/page.tsx: requireDoctor() server-side check, form with oldPassword, newPassword, confirmNewPassword, password strength indicator, POST to /api/auth/change-password-first-login, redirect to /doctor/dashboard on success
acceptance_criteria: Center admin can POST to /api/center/doctors/provision with doctor details and receive tempPassword once
Email verification sent to doctor (or notification created if email fails)
Doctor login with temp password succeeds but redirects to change-password page
Doctor cannot access any /doctor/* route except change-password until password reset
Password change with valid old/new passwords succeeds and allows full access
New device login triggers OTP generation and security email
Correct OTP verification marks device as trusted
Rate limiting prevents OTP brute force (max 3 attempts)
verification: Start dev server: npm run dev
Login as CENTER role user, POST to /api/center/doctors/provision with valid data, verify 200 response with tempPassword
Check email logs for verification email or check notifications table for fallback
Login as provisioned doctor with temp password, verify redirect to /doctor/change-password
Try accessing /doctor/dashboard before password change, verify redirect back to change-password
Submit password change with new password, verify success and redirect to dashboard
Clear cookies, login from 'new device' (clear localStorage deviceId), verify OTP email sent
Submit correct OTP to /api/auth/verify-device, verify device trusted in user_devices table
